results.query: How do I paint, erase, fill and undo in a first Workbench session?
results.bounded_context_answer: Keep the fresh Workbench paused; if it is running, pause it. Choose Paint, then Brush/B or Eraser/E (right-drag also erases). Focused text fields keep their keys; simulation invalidates construction history rather than providing physics rewind.
